definitions.explanation: The physical strength or force that muscles can exert. Commonly used in fitness, health, and medical contexts.

examples.japanese: {筋力|きんりょく}を{鍛|きた}える。
{年齢|ねんれい}とともに{筋力|きんりょく}が{低下|ていか}する。
{毎日|まいにち}スクワットをして{下半身|かはんしん}の{筋力|きんりょく}を{維持|いじ}するようにしている。
examples.english: I do squats every day to maintain my lower body muscle strength.

notes:
USAGE:
{筋力|きんりょく} is a common word in fitness, rehabilitation, and health discussions. It frequently appears in discussions about aging, exercise, and physical therapy.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {筋力|きんりょく}トレーニング (strength training)
- {筋力|きんりょく}を{鍛|きた}える (to train/build muscle strength)
- {筋力|きんりょく}が{低下|ていか}する (muscle strength declines)
- {筋力|きんりょく}を{維持|いじ}する (to maintain muscle strength)
- {筋力|きんりょく}アップ (increasing muscle strength)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{体力|たいりょく} refers to overall physical stamina and fitness, while {筋力|きんりょく} specifically refers to the strength of muscles.
